flt = frappe.utils.flt

def pl_sig(rows, flt=flt):
    parts = []
    for c in rows:
        parts.append(str(c.get("custom_item") or c.get("item_code") or c.get("description") or "") + "|" + str(round(flt(c.get("qty")), 3)) + "|" + str(round(flt(c.get("cost")), 2)) + "|" + str(round(flt(c.get("selling")), 2)))
    return ";".join(parts)

def ensure_pl(opp, reason, pl_sig=pl_sig, flt=flt):
    rows = opp.get("custom_costing") or []
    if not rows:
        return None
    sig = pl_sig(rows)
    old = None
    cur = opp.get("custom_pl")
    if cur and frappe.db.exists("Deal PL", cur):
        old = frappe.get_doc("Deal PL", cur)
        if old.docstatus == 1 and old.signature == sig:
            return old.name
    pl = frappe.new_doc("Deal PL")
    pl.opportunity = opp.name
    pl.currency = opp.get("currency")
    pl.conversion_rate = opp.get("conversion_rate")
    pl.signature = sig
    pl.revision = 1
    pl.reason = reason
    if old and old.docstatus == 1:
        old.flags.ignore_permissions = True
        old.flags.ignore_links = True
        old.cancel()
        pl.amended_from = old.name
        pl.revision = (old.revision or 1) + 1
    elif old and old.docstatus == 0:
        frappe.delete_doc("Deal PL", old.name, force=1, ignore_permissions=True)
    tc = 0
    ts = 0
    prs = []
    for c in rows:
        pl.append("lines", {"item_code": c.get("custom_item"), "line_type": c.get("custom_item_group"), "description": c.get("description"),
            "qty": c.get("qty"), "currency": opp.get("currency"), "cost": c.get("cost"), "margin": c.get("margin"),
            "selling": c.get("selling"), "pricing_request": c.get("pricing_request")})
        tc = tc + flt(c.get("cost"))
        ts = ts + flt(c.get("selling"))
        if c.get("pricing_request") and c.get("pricing_request") not in prs:
            prs.append(c.get("pricing_request"))
    pl.total_cost = tc
    pl.total_selling = ts
    pl.margin_pct = ((ts - tc) / ts * 100) if ts else 0
    pl.based_on = ", ".join(prs)
    pl.flags.ignore_permissions = True
    pl.insert()
    pl.submit()
    return pl.name

name: Eye Opportunity Auto Quotation
script:
flt = frappe.utils.flt
board = frappe.get_all("Kanban Board", filters={"reference_doctype": "Opportunity", "field_name": "sales_stage"}, pluck="name", limit=1)
stages = frappe.get_all("Kanban Board Column", filters={"parent": board[0]}, pluck="column_name", order_by="idx asc") if board else []
before = doc.get_doc_before_save()
was = before.sales_stage if before else None
qi = stages.index("Quotation") if "Quotation" in stages else -1
now_i = stages.index(doc.sales_stage) if doc.sales_stage in stages else -1
was_i = stages.index(was) if was in stages else -1
moved = (doc.has_value_changed("sales_stage") and qi >= 0 and now_i >= qi and was_i < qi
         and not frappe.db.exists("Quotation", {"opportunity": doc.name, "docstatus": 1}))
if moved or doc.flags.eye_make_quote:
    if not doc.items:
        frappe.throw("Add the sales items first: the quotation is made from them")
    missing = [str(r.idx) for r in (doc.get("custom_requirements") or []) if not r.item_code]
    if missing:
        frappe.throw("Requirement rows " + ", ".join(missing) + " have no sales item")
    total = 0.0
    for i in doc.items:
        total += flt(i.amount) or flt(i.qty) * flt(i.rate)
    if total + 0.005 < flt(doc.get("custom_total_selling")):
        frappe.throw("Items total " + frappe.utils.fmt_money(total, currency=doc.currency)
                     + " is below the minimum selling total "
                     + frappe.utils.fmt_money(doc.custom_total_selling, currency=doc.currency))
    new = frappe.call("erpnext.crm.doctype.opportunity.opportunity.make_quotation", source_name=doc.name)
    drafts = frappe.get_all("Quotation", filters={"opportunity": doc.name, "docstatus": 0, "creation": [">=", doc.creation], "custom_quote_type": "Full", "custom_superseded": 0},
                            pluck="name", order_by="creation desc", limit=1)
    if drafts:
        q = frappe.get_doc("Quotation", drafts[0])
        q.set("items", [])
        for i in new.items:
            row = i.as_dict()
            for k in ["name", "parent", "parenttype", "parentfield", "idx", "creation", "modified",
                      "owner", "modified_by", "docstatus", "doctype"]:
                row.pop(k, None)
            q.append("items", row)
        q.flags.ignore_permissions = True
        q.save()
    else:
        if not new.valid_till:
            new.valid_till = frappe.utils.add_days(frappe.utils.nowdate(), 30)
        new.flags.ignore_permissions = True
        new.insert()

name: Eye Opportunity Sync Cost Sheet
script:
WITH_PROD = "With Production"
reqs = doc.get("custom_requirements") or []
codes = {}
for r in reqs:
    codes[r.name] = r.item_code
priced = [c.requirement for c in (doc.get("custom_costing") or [])]
for name in frappe.get_all("Pricing Request", filters={"opportunity": doc.name, "status": WITH_PROD, "docstatus": 0}, pluck="name"):
    lines = frappe.get_all("Pricing Request Item", filters={"parenttype": "Pricing Request", "parent": name},
                           fields=["name", "requirement", "idx", "custom_sales_item"])
    have = [l.requirement for l in lines]
    others = frappe.get_all("Pricing Request Item",
                            filters={"parenttype": "Pricing Request", "parent": ["!=", name],
                                     "requirement": ["in", list(codes.keys()) or ["-"]]}, pluck="requirement")
    for l in lines:
        if l.requirement in codes and l.custom_sales_item != codes[l.requirement]:
            frappe.db.set_value("Pricing Request Item", l.name, "custom_sales_item", codes[l.requirement], update_modified=False)
    idx = max([l.idx for l in lines] or [0])
    for r in reqs:
        if r.name in have or r.name in priced or r.name in others:
            continue
        idx += 1
        frappe.get_doc({"doctype": "Pricing Request Item", "parent": name, "parenttype": "Pricing Request",
                        "parentfield": "items", "idx": idx, "requirement": r.name,
                        "custom_sales_item": r.item_code, "description": r.description, "qty": r.qty,
                        "notes": r.notes, "attachment": r.attachment}).insert(ignore_permissions=True)

name: Eye Billing Request After Save
script:
# Billing Request · After Save: the rules are in the "Eye Billing API" Server Script (eye.billing).
frappe.call("eye.billing", op="br_on_update", doc=doc)

name: Eye Billing Request Before Save
script:
# Billing Request · Before Save: the rules are in the "Eye Billing API" Server Script (eye.billing).
frappe.call("eye.billing", op="br_validate", doc=doc)

name: Eye Quotation After Save
script:
# Quotation · After Save: saving a quotation moves the deal to Quotation.
# The rules are in the "Eye Pricing API" Server Script (eye.pricing).
frappe.call("eye.pricing", op="q_on_update", doc=doc)

name: Eye Quotation Before Save
script:
# Quotation · Before Save: pricing must be done and the net total above the minimum.
# The rules are in the "Eye Pricing API" Server Script (eye.pricing).
# a "Changes only" quotation carries the difference only, so the deal minimum does not apply to it
if doc.get("custom_quote_type") != "Changes only":
    frappe.call("eye.pricing", op="q_validate", doc=doc)

name: Eye Pricing Request Before Delete
script:
# Pricing Request · Before Delete: only an unstarted request can be deleted.
# The rules are in the "Eye Pricing API" Server Script (eye.pricing).
frappe.call("eye.pricing", op="pr_on_trash", doc=doc)

name: Eye Pricing Request After Save
script:
# Pricing Request · After Save: first cost starts the pricing; edits before Sales starts flow to the deal.
# The rules are in the "Eye Pricing API" Server Script (eye.pricing).
frappe.call("eye.pricing", op="pr_on_update", doc=doc)

name: Eye Pricing Request After Insert
script:
# Pricing Request · After Insert: assigns the request to Production.
# The rules are in the "Eye Pricing API" Server Script (eye.pricing).
frappe.call("eye.pricing", op="pr_after_insert", doc=doc)

name: Eye Pricing Request Before Save
script:
# Pricing Request · Before Save: who may change the costs now, cost totals per line.
# The rules are in the "Eye Pricing API" Server Script (eye.pricing).
frappe.call("eye.pricing", op="pr_validate", doc=doc)

name: Eye Opportunity After Save
script:
# Opportunity · After Save: a request Production has not started follows the requirements.
# The rules are in the "Eye Pricing API" Server Script (eye.pricing).
frappe.call("eye.pricing", op="opp_on_update", doc=doc)

name: Eye Opportunity Before Save
script:
# Opportunity · Before Save: the stage gates. A move to a later stage needs every step of the stages it passes.
# The rules are in the "Eye Pricing API" Server Script (eye.pricing): deal_steps.
frappe.call("eye.pricing", op="opp_validate", doc=doc)

name: Eye Opportunity Before Validate
script:
# Opportunity · Before Validate: locks requirements Production started on, recalculates the costing and the pricing status.
# The rules are in the "Eye Pricing API" Server Script (eye.pricing).
frappe.call("eye.pricing", op="opp_before_validate", doc=doc)

name: Eye Zoho Webhook
script:
# Zoho Books calls this when an estimate, a sales order, an invoice or a payment changes:
#   https://SITE/api/method/eye.zoho_webhook?secret=WEBHOOK_SECRET
# It only asks for a check; the 5-minute job (Eye Books Every 5 Minutes) reads Zoho and answers.
secret = frappe.get_doc("Eye Books Settings", "Eye Books Settings").get_password("webhook_secret", raise_exception=False)
if not secret or frappe.form_dict.get("secret") != secret:
    frappe.throw(_("Not permitted"), frappe.PermissionError)
frappe.db.set_value("Eye Books Settings", "Eye Books Settings", "check_requested", 1)
frappe.flags.result = "ok"
